description: Convenience wrapper around search_startups pre-tuned for fresh-stealth deal-flow. Always sends stealth=true and sort=founded_date.desc; those two cannot be changed here. Returns stealth startups with their detected tech stack (CDN, email provider, analytics), RDAP domain registration date, and a has_known_emails flag indicating whether at least one founder/team email has been verified. Inputs: domain_tld (default 'ai,io,so,xyz,security'), with_emails (default true, which sends has_known_emails=true; pass false to drop that filter), founded_after, country, cdn, email_provider, limit (default 20, max 100). There is no offset; use search_startups with stealth=true to page further. Pro Lite tier and higher only (Free tier 403s). Pro Lite sees redacted emails; Pro tier sees full. Combine with list_startup_team and discover_email to surface the actual addresses. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

country.description: Optional comma-separated HQ countries, names or ISO codes.

domain_tld.description: Comma-separated TLDs. Defaults to 'ai,io,so,xyz,security' (the high-signal AI-native TLDs).

email_provider.description: Optional comma-separated email_provider filter (e.g. 'm365,self_hosted' to find non-Google-Workspace stealth shops).

founded_after.description: Only stealth startups founded on or after this date: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

with_emails.description: When true (default), only return startups with at least one verified founder/team email (has_known_emails=true). False drops that filter.

name: find_stealth_startups
title: Find stealth startups
